title: Taniya and the Little Baker Worms
author: Mojtaba Roozegar
short_description: Step into a tiny garden bakery with Taniya and three cheerful baker worms. Together they gather berries, mix and knead, bake a towering cake, and share it with their friends in this warm, rhythmic picture book.
long_description: Under a berry bush, Taniya discovers a tiny bakery and meets Pip, Poppy, and Peep - three little worms with big baker smiles. Follow their sing-song adventure as they plan a recipe, pick berries, gather ingredients, stir and knead the dough, decorate a tall cake, and prepare a garden feast. When a playful breeze sends napkins flying, the friends work together and keep the celebration joyful. With colorful storybook illustrations and short rhyming verses, this read-aloud tale celebrates teamwork, kindness, patience, and sharing.
disclaimer: Digital illustrated storybook. Suggested ages 3-8. Sale price $4 USD (regular $18; discount $14).
